findings.proposed_change:
Extract a shared coefficient-descent lemma before both proofs. A proposed statement, using the current imports, is:

private lemma countable_presentation_coefficients
    {K : Type} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (q : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (hq : Ideal.span (q : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) = I)
    (d : Finset K) (hd : q.biUnion MvPolynomial.coeffs ⊆ d)
    (c : Set K) (hc : c.Countable) :
    ∃ S : Subfield K, Countable S ∧ c ⊆ S ∧
      (∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K, f.coeffs ⊆ d →
        ∃ f₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) S,
          MvPolynomial.map S.subtype f₀ = f) ∧
      (I.comap (MvPolynomial.map S.subtype)).map
        (MvPolynomial.map S.subtype) = I

Proof sketch: take S = Subfield.closure (c ∪ ↑d), establish countability with cardinalMk_closure_le_max, and lift polynomials using mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset. For the ideal equality, use map_comap_le in one direction; in the other, rewrite I using hq and lift every generator using hd. This extracts the combined descent argument, not merely its final equivalence wrapper.

In countable_polynomial_model, retain the finite-presentation setup and replace lines 292–311 with:

let d : Finset K := q.biUnion MvPolynomial.coeffs
obtain ⟨S, hcount, hcS, _, hI⟩ :=
  countable_presentation_coefficients I q hq d
    (by intro x hx; exact hx) c hc
refine ⟨S, hcount, hcS, n,
  I.comap (MvPolynomial.map S.subtype), ?_⟩

Then retain the equivalence construction at lines 312–313.

In countable_model_with_elements, retain the chosen representatives p and the existing definition of d, then replace lines 340–358 with:

obtain ⟨S, hcount, hcS, lift_poly, hI⟩ :=
  countable_presentation_coefficients I q hq d
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hx) c hc
let I₀ := I.comap (MvPolynomial.map S.subtype)

The existing hp₀ proof uses the returned lift_poly directly; hI supplies the equality needed by the existing e₀ construction. Use hcS in the final existential instead of reproving containment. Retain the marked-element verification at lines 368–375. No new imports or domain assumptions are needed. Empty generator sets, n = 0, k = 0, and the zero algebra remain permitted.
findings.benefit: Both proofs expose their genuine difference—whether extra element coefficients must be included—while countability, polynomial lifting, and ideal descent are maintained in one place. Keeping the existing equivalence and marked-element verification avoids introducing an additional compatibility API.

let S := Subfield.closure (c ∪ (d : Set K))
  have hcount : Countable S := Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0_iff.mp
    ((Subfield.cardinalMk_closure_le_max _).trans (max_le
      ((hc.union d.countable_toSet).le_aleph0) le_rfl))

have hI : I₀.map (MvPolynomial.map S.subtype) = I := by
    apply le_antisymm Ideal.map_comap_le
    rw [← hq]
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨f₀, rfl⟩ := lift_poly f (fun x hx => Finset.mem_union_left _
      (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨f, hf, hx⟩))
    apply Ideal.mem_map_of_mem
    exact Ideal.subset_span hf

have lift_poly (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (hf : f.coeffs ⊆ d) :
      ∃ f₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) S, MvPolynomial.map S.subtype f₀ = f := by
    apply MvPolynomial.mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (hf hx))⟩, rfl⟩

lemma mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset {f : R →+* S₁} {x : MvPolynomial σ S₁} :
    x ∈ Set.range (MvPolynomial.map f) ↔ (x.coeffs : Set _) ⊆ .range f := by
